notes: Behaviour only: an agent created a scheduled automation nobody asked for. Nothing in the text is a code identifier, and the fix is a tool-description string. The case where grep on a product noun may well beat a call graph — worth keeping for exactly that reason.
title: Agent unexpectedly creates automation for PR monitoring
body:
When asked to monitor a pull request and keep it green, the agent created a scheduled automation without confirming that this was intended.

Expected: treat monitoring as active work in the current session (for example, wait for checks and poll for updates), unless the user explicitly asks for recurring or scheduled automation.

Actual: a persistent hourly automation was created. This was surprising and provided a worse follow-up experience than active in-session monitoring.
